title: World Trivia Quiz Board
description: Test your knowledge of geography, inventions, nature, and sports in this team quiz board!

thumbnail.alt: A glowing globe surrounded by trivia symbols like a lightbulb, compass, and medal

What metal is liquid at room temperature?
What is the fastest land animal in the world?
Which bird is famous for being unable to fly and swimming in icy Antarctic waters?
What is the largest coral reef system on Earth?
Which giant ocean mammal has a heart roughly the size of a small car?
How many rings are on the official Olympic flag?

How many players are on the field for one soccer team during a match?
